labels.calendarSyncModeHelp: Personal setting. Applies to your Google account only. Records with **Add to Google Calendar** still export on save regardless of this mode.

help.GoogleIntegration: Connect your Google account for **Calendar** and **Drive** access used by this Espo instance (`drive.file` scope). Disconnect clears stored tokens on this server. After connecting, choose your optional background sync mode below and click **Save**.
